blocks.text: This Vehicle Financing Agreement ("Loan Agreement") is made as of {{loan_date}} between:
The Vehicle is the primary collateral for this loan. Lender will hold a lien on the Vehicle's title until the loan is fully paid.
The loan proceeds will be used to: {{loan_use}} (purchase the Vehicle from {{seller_name}} / refinance existing loan with {{existing_lender}} / other: {{other_use}}).

items: Borrower grants Lender a security interest in the Vehicle as collateral for this loan.
Lender will perfect its security interest by holding the Vehicle's title or filing a lien on the title with the DMV.
Borrower will not sell, transfer, lease, or encumber the Vehicle without Lender's prior written consent.
Borrower must maintain the Vehicle in good condition and not commit any act that impairs Lender's security interest.
If Borrower sells the Vehicle before the loan is paid, Borrower must pay off the loan in full before transferring title.
Borrower must maintain comprehensive and collision insurance on the Vehicle throughout the loan term.
Lender must be named as loss payee on the insurance policy.

Coverage limits: liability — {{liability_minimum}} per person / {{liability_per_accident}} per accident; collision deductible — {{collision_deductible}}; comprehensive deductible — {{comprehensive_deductible}}.
Borrower must provide proof of insurance to Lender before taking possession and annually thereafter.
If insurance lapses, Lender may purchase force-placed insurance at Borrower's expense.
Failure to make a payment within {{grace_period}} days of the due date constitutes default.
Failure to maintain insurance constitutes default.
Bankruptcy or insolvency of Borrower constitutes default.
Unauthorized sale, transfer, or encumbrance of the Vehicle constitutes default.
Upon default, Lender may declare the full remaining balance immediately due and payable (acceleration).
Upon default, Lender may repossess the Vehicle, sell it, and apply proceeds to the loan balance. Borrower is responsible for any deficiency.

blocks.text: Upon Borrower's request, Lender will provide a payoff statement showing the total amount required to pay off the loan in full as of a given date. Payoff statements are valid for {{payoff_statement_validity}} days.
This Loan Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}.
